description: The file 'PlatformImplementation.cpp' contains implementation code for display information handling within a Linux environment, including classes for observing udev device events, querying display properties via DRM, managing EDID data, and handling HDR and graphics properties. It also implements the core logic for a plugin that integrates with the WPEFramework to provide display connection status, resolution, and HDCP information, with notification mechanisms for changes.

classes.name: UdevObserverType
classes.description: A class that listens to Linux udev events via netlink socket and invokes registered callbacks based on device type changes.

classes.name: GraphicsProperties
classes.description: Implements graphics memory information querying by reading specified files to get total and free GPU RAM.

classes.name: HDRProperties
classes.description: Provides HDR level information by reading from a specified HDR level file.

classes.name: DisplayProperties
classes.description: Manages display connection properties, EDID data, HDCP status, and querying display details using DRM and file-based sources.

classes.name: DisplayInfoImplementation
classes.description: Main implementation class for the display info plugin. Manages display state, subscribes to udev events, notifies observers, and exposes display properties via implemented interfaces.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Reads the first line from a specified file.
